rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a diaper of any usual type.

example.english: The little one needs a diaper change.
example.jyutping: go3 sai3 lou6 jiu3 wun6 niu6 pin2 laa3

rows.note: Use this when you specifically mean a disposable paper diaper.

example.english: When I take my son out, I use a disposable diaper.
example.traditional: 帶阿仔出街，我會用紙尿片。
example.jyutping: daai3 aa3 zai2 ceot1 gaai1 ngo5 wui5 jung6 zi2 niu6 pin2

rows.note: Use this for a reusable cloth diaper rather than a disposable one.

example.english: Mum used a cloth diaper in the past, washed it, and used it again.
example.traditional: 以前阿媽會用尿布，洗完再用。
example.jyutping: ji5 cin4 aa3 maa1 wui5 jung6 niu6 bou3 sai2 jyun4 zoi3 jung6

rows.note: This is a casual shorthand used when the childcare context already makes “diaper” clear.

example.english: The kid is awake, so it’s time to change the diaper.
example.jyutping: go3 zai2 fan3 sing2 zau6 jiu3 wun6 pin2 laa3
